statement: The function returns a result r such that r is a rearrangement of nums (the same length and the same multiset of values), and for every i with 1 <= i < len(r) - 1, 2 * r[i] != r[i-1] + r[i+1].
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 100000; for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].
